risks.title: Unsupported and uncited financial claims can pass output validation
risks.current_assessment: agent_output_v2 requires typed material claims, snapshot-scoped lineage, evidence-family compatibility, conservative direct-fact support, and symmetric field-aware numerical grounding before publication or cache.

risks.title: Successful paid output can be cached before its ledger row exists
risks.current_assessment: Phase 7.1 established ledger-before-cache, rollback on final ledger failure, attempt records, and cache-parent validation; live artifacts confirm linkage.

risks.title: Full real evidence snapshot can be sent externally without a field-minimized egress contract
risks.current_assessment: Synthetic live testing was privacy-safe and Phase 7.3B made no external call. Phase 8 may begin as a local deterministic fusion phase; any future real-data external egress still requires field minimization and separate authorization.

risks.title: Prompt text changes need not invalidate agent cache
risks.current_assessment: Prompt SHA-256, prompt version, schema, harness, config, and validator versions are included in v2 cache identity; old agent_output_v1 cache cannot validate as v2.

risks.title: Risk cannot veto or abstain a future synthesis
risks.current_assessment: No Phase 7 model orchestrator or final synthesis exists, so this is not a Phase 7 runtime defect. Phase 8 must define deterministic Risk veto/abstain and partial-team policy before fusion.

risks.title: Direct facts and interpretations are not machine-distinguished
risks.evidence: agent_output_v2 adds claim_type, support_type, evidence_type, evidence_ids, confidence, and material and enforces conservative compatibility/direct-fact rules.

risks.title: Material limitations and uncertainty can bypass per-claim lineage
risks.evidence: Limitations, uncertainty, and Risk missing-evidence entries now use the same required typed claim object and evidence lineage as primary claims.

risks.title: Numerical semantic field matching is stronger for Bull than Bear/Risk
risks.evidence: numerical_grounding_v3 applies one field/unit/currency/category validator to Bull, Bear, and Risk with symmetric offline tests.

risks.title: Dashboard does not expose the full durable agent audit trail
risks.evidence: Ledger retains run, attempt, failure, usage, and cache state; UI shows role status, factors, confidence, time, and limited pipeline health.
risks.next_control: Expose run ID and validation state later if product observability requires it; never expose chain-of-thought.

risks.title: Another integrated paid run may be mistaken for a semantic-grounding fix
risks.evidence: All three roles have live synthetic coverage and the deterministic aggregator has offline integration coverage; another call does not add claim typing.
